drafted.title: Org shell, dashboard, settings, billing read-only

open_issues: Super admins are not org members (DESIGN §5), so the founder trialling as super admin gets 404 on /o/<slug>/* unless he invites/creates himself as the first church admin in /admin/churches/[orgId]; 3.1 documents this and the orchestrator may want 2.5's checklist (G6) to say so, or a later step to let super admins open org pages read-only.

Guard names/signatures are chosen by G5 (2.1) in parallel: 3.1 assumes DESIGN §2's src/lib/auth/{require-user,require-org,require-perm,require-super}.ts with requireOrgMember(slug) / requirePerm(ctx, perm) (PLAN §8 names) and tells the agent to extend whatever exists; the assembler should align 3.1–3.5 if G5 chose different names.
Post-login landing for non-super users (/o → profiles.last_org_id) is placed in 3.1; if G5's 2.1 already redirects members elsewhere, the two must be reconciled at assembly.

403 handling relies on Next forbidden() + experimental.authInterrupts (assumed still experimental in Next 16.3) with an error.tsx fallback; G10 (3.7 Playwright) should assert whichever mechanism HANDOFF records.

Settings Zod schema: 3.1 uses organizationSettingsSchema from @church/domain and creates packages/domain/src/schemas/settings.ts only if 1.6 (G4, drafted in parallel) did not; G4 should export a schema by that name or the assembler renames one side.

Logo replacement leaves orphan objects in org-assets (no delete policy for authenticated per DESIGN §6) until the 3.6 cron orphan sweep; immediate cleanup would need a service-client path that the skeleton reserves for cron/service — not built in 3.1.
billing_subscriptions columns beyond status/status_raw/event_created (e.g. period end) were fixed by G2 (1.2) and G6 (2.3); 3.1's billing page shows only what exists in 9999_init.sql.

Prompt length is 3141 words, slightly above orchestrator decision 9's 3000 ceiling (validator warns only above 3400); the assembler may trim boilerplate or accept it, as G3 did for its DB-heavy steps.
